verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail documents some per-item control over physical mail: you can ask that an item not be opened or scanned and have it shipped to you instead ("You decide the best way to handle your mail"). It also offers scanning on request, forwarding, and automation rules for handling mail. The evidence never mentions a physical storage window, shredding, or disposal, and its "unlimited cloud storage" refers to digital scans, not physical retention. Missing for 10: documented physical storage windows, on-request shredding with confirmation, explicit per-item disposal options, and independent corroboration.
